scope: Whole current spine. Teaching choices and topic placements come from the existing plan and hall cards; this file supplies only the global visual arrangement and proposed building associations.

sequences.label: Primitives
sequences.relation: Begin with a point and construct a body.
sequences.build: A reusable wedge and cube construction kit.

association.title: Buildable forms
association.description: Turn the familiar wedge and cube into joined, walkable modules; preserve the geometry recipe.

sequences.label: Transformation
sequences.relation: Change a familiar whole body.
sequences.build: Move, turn and resize a constructed body.

association.title: Moving crossing
association.description: Give the same landing or bridge a time-driven pose; establish passenger collision before using it as a route.

sequences.label: Arrays
sequences.relation: Return to the lists first used in Trace.
sequences.build: Address many independent modules and distinguish copies from shared references.

association.title: Module field
association.description: Arrange known cubes and wedges through stored addresses. Static placement can be an early bridge into this sequence.

sequences.label: Colour
sequences.relation: Give addressed bodies independent materials.
sequences.build: Keep a palette separate from the objects receiving it.

association.title: Signal panels
association.description: Reuse a palette across lights, panels and signs while preserving each receiver’s state.

sequences.label: Tiling
sequences.relation: Read one source through repeated interpretations.
sequences.build: Repeat a source across surfaces and frames.

association.title: Patterned screen
association.description: Make a screen, facade or garment from the same source and declared repeat operation.

sequences.label: Change
sequences.relation: Measure the motion instead of only prescribing it.
sequences.build: Read and accumulate changes in a position or field.

association.title: Flow channel
association.description: A marked route makes the difference between direction, speed and accumulated distance visible.

sequences.label: Forces
sequences.relation: Retain velocity and change it through acceleration.
sequences.build: Let a familiar body respond to forces and constraints.

association.title: Force apparatus
association.description: Build a launcher or spring-supported platform with a bounded, measurable response.

sequences.label: Form finding
sequences.relation: Seek an arrangement under declared constraints.
sequences.build: Find a candidate form instead of prescribing every position.

association.title: Tension canopy
association.description: Use supports and load constraints to explore a cable or canopy form; appearance is not a load certification.

sequences.label: Waves
sequences.relation: Deepen the periodic motion preview.
sequences.build: Drive familiar forms with periodic values and compare phase.

association.title: Wave passage
association.description: A row of familiar bodies becomes a phase-controlled passage; sound and walkable motion need distinct receivers.

sequences.label: Randomness
sequences.relation: Choose values for an addressed population and retain the recipe.
sequences.build: Generate repeatable samples, placements and walks.

association.title: Seeded encounter
association.description: Keep a seed and draw policy so an obstacle arrangement can be replayed and compared.

sequences.label: Noise
sequences.relation: Compare related samples with independent draws.
sequences.build: Use a field to drive positions, occupancy or a surface.

association.title: Field landscape
association.description: Drive terrain or a wind-like influence from the same sampled field; declare the receiver and threshold.

sequences.label: Shaders
sequences.relation: Move known rules onto a surface.
sequences.build: Evaluate known distance, colour, tiling and noise operations per fragment.

association.title: Responsive skin
association.description: Let a familiar body carry a surface rule. Stored simulation feedback requires explicit previous-state buffers.

sequences.label: Cellular automata
sequences.relation: Give an addressed grid current and next state.
sequences.build: Step a local rule without mixing old and new state.

association.title: Living light wall
association.description: Use cell state to drive an architectural light wall; keep a small hand-checkable generation visible.

sequences.label: Fractals
sequences.relation: Repeat a known construction with a stopping rule.
sequences.build: Generate nested structure under a finite budget.

association.title: Branching scaffold
association.description: Repeat a construction at smaller scales; budget depth, pieces and collision explicitly.

sequences.label: L-systems
sequences.relation: Separate a description from its spatial interpretation.
sequences.build: Build a branching body from a rewritten word and saved turtle state.

association.title: Rule-grown frame
association.description: Use a grammar to describe a plant-like scaffold or passage; preserve both word and interpretation.

sequences.label: Generated worlds
sequences.relation: Combine construction rules with candidate records and criteria.
sequences.build: Generate bounded candidates and compare what a criterion selects.

association.title: Recoverable maze
association.description: Keep the seed, connections and construction recipe for a generated maze or room assembly.

sequences.label: Soft bodies
sequences.relation: Let a body’s vertices move under constraints.
sequences.build: Compare a deformable sheet or body under declared pinned boundaries.

association.title: Working tarp
association.description: Use a hanging tarp or flexible bridge as a controlled constraint study; test its physical role separately.

sequences.label: Isosurfaces
sequences.relation: Extract a boundary from sampled values.
sequences.build: Turn scalar samples into a finite explicit surface.

association.title: Field-carved passage
association.description: Generate a cave or passage from a field and threshold; collision is a separate output to validate.

sequences.label: Solid operations
sequences.relation: Use familiar bodies as ordered operands.
sequences.build: Compose solids and compare A minus B with B minus A.

association.title: Cut doorway
association.description: Cut an inhabitable opening from known solids and inspect the visible and physical boundaries.

sequences.label: Swarms
sequences.relation: Return to local rules with moving agents and different forms of coordination.
sequences.build: Let many points act through neighbours, fields or retained traces.

association.title: Guiding swarm
association.description: Explore lights or agents that reveal a route through local rules; navigation remains a distinct game contract.

sequences.label: Graphs
sequences.relation: Make the relation records explicit and independent of their drawing.
sequences.build: Keep connectivity while changing layout; search or allocate over it.

association.title: Route switchboard
association.description: Use a saved connection graph to change which passages link, then test reachability.

sequences.label: Learning systems
sequences.relation: Separate a computation’s connections from weights that change.
sequences.build: Fit or evaluate a model using declared data and retained comparisons.

association.title: Taught controller
association.description: Explore a gate or body controlled by a learned mapping; compare held-out cases and retain a manual fallback.

sequences.label: Foundations / limits
sequences.relation: Return to what a construction can and cannot establish.
sequences.build: Build bounded witnesses while keeping interpretation and proof distinct.

association.title: Assumption room
association.description: Return to lines, geometry and connection rules; change one stated assumption and delimit the claim.

sequences.label: QFEP laboratory
sequences.relation: Make model terms and their limits available for controlled comparison.
sequences.build: Keep inputs beside a calculated result and compare different arrangements.

association.title: Comparison bench
association.description: A configurable bench preserves arrangements, totals and model assumptions without treating them as a universal physical law.

sequences.label: After the crisis
sequences.relation: Carry revised constructions and explicit limits into another encounter.
sequences.build: Retain alternative arrangements and explain what the record preserves or omits.

association.title: Revision room
association.description: Reopen two versions of a construction and keep the differences legible; the recoverable assembly remains a proposal where no code exists.

orderQuestion.title: Could Arrays come before Transformation?
orderQuestion.note: Basic arrays and loops already enter in Trace. Early static repetition could strengthen construction. Moving the complete Arrays sequence requires reconciling its declared Transformation dependencies; compare before changing the spine.
orderQuestion.action: Preview only. No curriculum, map layout, lesson or review state is written by this graph.
